releases.name: The Red Cathedral
releases.summary:
Tsar Ivan the Terrible has ordered the construction of a cathedral in honor of his military victories. Many teams of builders will take part in the construction, but only one of them will stand out and gain the favor of the Tsar!

The Red Cathedral is a fun turn-based strategy game for 1 to 4 players. Manage your resources well to build the cathedral better than anyone else and thus win the Tsar's favor.

releases.name: ROBOTEKA
releases.summary: A unique robot fighting action game built around simple controls, precise timing, and martial arts-inspired combat.

releases.name: Sir Loot-a-Lot
releases.summary: Medieval turn-based loot RPG. Skills are cards dealt each turn—spend 4 AP in any order. Sword, spear, and bow swap as you fight; add poison, fire, or frost; chain duplicates into combos. Forked runs lead through elites, vaults, and merchants to unique bosses. Relics reshape play;

releases.name: The Cozy Funemployment
releases.summary: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.

releases.name: Crime and Punishment
releases.summary: Re-live the magic, the mystery, and the illusion of the battles between the gods and the demons. What is seen may not be the reality, and what is the reality may not be seen.  The "gods" are represented by "Hanuman", who is attacked by thousands of "asuras" (demons). Each asur can be killed by a unique weapon. They possess magical powers, can appear anywhere, can come invisible ...The gods in the heavens help Hanuman by dropping magical flowers that give life-energy and weapons which give points that can be used to buy new weapons. However, you need to watch out for the fake flowers dropped by demonic forces, which would explode and end the game.The game introduces each asur one by one alongwith the unique weapon that kills it in the earlier levels that serve as a "War Training". Once you are through this, you can experience the real "Battle", which would surely put your mental focus and physical reflexes to an ultimate test.This is a preview version of the app, which shows 3 such asuras and a few of their magical illusions. The future versions will allow you to experience hundreds of such asuras and their magical powers.Let go of the reality for a while and experience the magical, the illusionary, the "Maya" of it all ...

releases.name: Thorn Beach
releases.summary: Relax with hand-drawn animated jigsaw puzzles that reveal animated, cozy scenes from the everyday lives of the charming creatures (and monsters) of Thorn Beach.

releases.name: Tidyspell
releases.summary: Tidyspell is a cozy first person magical cleaning game where you use telekinesis and spells to tidy a whimsical home, uncover hidden creatures, grow stronger, and explore impossible spaces, secret rooms, and mysterious portals.

releases.name: Ice Cream Truck Simulator
releases.summary: Start your engine and cool down the city! Hop into your fully interactive ice cream truck, drive through the neighborhood, and build your own ice cream empire. Take orders, scoop the perfect flavors, operate the card terminal, and manage your inventory on your ingame laptop.

releases.name: No Love No Money
releases.summary: Love or Money? Or maybe destroy both? No Love No Money is a comedy dating sim with detective elements, parodying popular anime and video game tropes.

releases.name: The Rouge Casino
releases.summary: Eight crooked casino tables, one roguelite spine. Rig the wheel, load the dice, mark the cards — stack charms, omens and gilded editions until the house edge is yours. Eight antes, eight stakes, eighty challenges, Endless beyond. No real gambling — just a casino you finally get to cheat.

releases.name: EVERYONE'S TIER LIST!
releases.summary: A party game that gets everyone excited with a tiered chart. Arrange five words based on a given theme, and have other players guess the order. It also includes a viewer-participation mode designed for streamers. With custom genres, the possibilities for themes are endless.

releases.name: Journey TD
releases.summary: Classic tower defense meets roguelite: draft elements, combine from 167 towers, and forge your perfect build with items, runes, and a massive skill tree. Control the paths your enemies take, survive procedurally generated maps and grow stronger with every run.

releases.name: Hell is Neon Colored
releases.summary: A minimalist neon action RPG where every sound is synthesized live on a virtual sound chip and every floor is built the moment you walk into it. Assemble weapons from eight power sources and twenty-odd parts, then find out how far down your build can take you.

releases.name: Arena of the Forge
releases.summary: Fight. Loot. Forge. Repeat. Arena of the Forge is a pixel art endless arena battler. Fight through waves of enemies and bosses to collect and forge stronger gear in the Arena or enter the Onslaught for a boss rush experience.

releases.name: Elsewhere (eMbAh)
releases.summary: Activate every shape in abstract logic puzzles built from gems, signals, and shifting paths. Learn each gem's rule, solve an 84-level campaign, then build and share your own levels through the editor and Steam Workshop.

releases.name: Chinatsu
releases.summary: 你将扮演一个被AI淘汰的程序员，回到那个停滞的小县城，与那个等了你十二年的女孩一起去寻找，从所有人记忆里消失的发小和尘封的往事，你们追查的不仅仅是真相，还是被AI一起困住的那个夏天、那座小城、那段永远不会结束的等待。

releases.name: Moonberry Clock: Idle Pet
releases.summary: Watch the clock and your idle pet passively gain money to unlock clothes, toys, and fun accessories. Either customize your pet yourself, or schedule them to change looks on their own.

releases.name: JOHN GLEEP
releases.summary: JOHN GLEEP is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.

releases.name: Just Up: 2D Platformer
releases.summary: Only Up: 2D Platformer is a vertical platformer where the goal is to reach the top. Jump and dash across platforms as you climb higher. Discover new places, explore changing environments, leave the atmosphere behind, and find out what awaits you at the top...

releases.name: Catalyst Core
releases.summary: A grid-based roguelike deckbuilder where every move sets up your next reaction. Build your deck, collect Elemental Cores and chain powerful elemental combos to defeat your enemies.

releases.name: Aleef: Desktop Pet Collector
releases.summary: Work, browse, or play other games while hatching eggs in the background! Collect 300+ pets with various stats, unlock powerful upgrades, and build your battle team.

releases.name: Monty's Idle Mine
releases.summary: A relaxing cozy idle game that lives on the bottom of your screen. Watch Monty mine and find treasures. Upgrade his skills and minerals, and decorate his world while you work and relax.

releases.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
releases.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

releases.name: Click Dystopia
releases.summary: Click Dystopia is a casual clicker Incremental game, where you click a button to slay virtual people for cash.

releases.name: Dream Glitcher
releases.summary: Dream Glitcher is a hand-drawn 2D point-and-click cyberpunk adventure that plays like an interactive graphic novel, blending dark psychological mystery with dark sci-fi atmosphere in a vibrant retro-futuristic world. Enter the memories of an android Luna and help her understand what she has become.

releases.name: THAT BOMB GAME
releases.summary: A dangerous bomb game up to 12 players where you'll have to type words fast to save yourself from exploding. Use power-up cards to control the game, only the last player standing wins.

releases.name: The Offering Hour
releases.summary: In an arena watched by gods and demons, you are the Sacrificer. Time is your only currency — and your life: summon monsters, utter dark rites, wear the monster's skin, all paid in the hours you have left. A strategy-action roguelike. One gate — only one side walks free.

releases.name: Mining Away!
releases.summary: Mining Away! is a short incremental game in which you mine ores, collect resources, progress through the vast skill tree, and unlock powerful pickaxes!

releases.name: Neon Impact 360 - Muliplayer Arcade Action
releases.summary: Four walls. Four paddles. One ball that never slows down. Defend your wall in a neon arcade showdown where every goal you let in brings you closer to defeat — across 30 levels of gravity wells, pinball chaos and mind-bending illusions, solo or with three friends.

releases.name: Shelves Full of Figures
releases.summary: A room full of empty shelves and a floor full of little figures. Pick up each one, find the shelf where it belongs and put it back on! Earn ability points as you go and unlock new ways to move and sort in this relaxing first-person organizing game.

releases.name: Buzzopolis: Hive Incremental
releases.summary:
Buzzopolis: Hive Incremental is an incremental roguelite colony sim in pixel art style.

Build a thriving hive, upgrade your colony, and experiment with resources and strategies. But beware: mutations accumulate, cells become infected, and eventually, it's easier to blow it all up. Activate the Phoenix Protocol, keep your bonuses, and start a new, stronger cycle.

Progress, chaos, and a bit of humor - all in one hive!
